Install Tuka

Add Tuka to your home screen and open it as an app.

On Android, open this site in Chrome, then tap its menu ⋮ and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. If you opened Tuka inside ChatGPT, first choose Open in browser.

Installing keeps the same Tuka features. For ride alerts, keep the app visible; locking the phone can pause location updates.
